environmentNotes: ~10:06 device time an unintended click on the App Live left toolbar (Profile Performance) started a BrowserStack performance profiling session; it was stopped immediately and the DevTools panel collapsed. This likely consumed one of the account's free performance reports (banner showed '2/3 free report(s) left'). No effect on the app under test.

Test data created this run (user-approved): 3-leg Multi submitted as 3 separate inquiries (Local, Outstation 672, Transfer) - all cancelled together via 672 (INV-81); single-leg Multi inquiry 685 cancelled (INV-82). No payment links created.

cases.actual: Multi tab: 'Leg #1 Local' with Local (selected) / Outstation / Transfer chips; Local leg fields (Pickup Location, Pickup Date & Time, Number of Passengers, Number of Hours, Additional Options Multi-day trip / Different drop location); 'Add Next Journey' button (renamed from 'Add Next Stop' in this build); Search Vehicles 'You won't be charged yet!'.

Add Next Journey with Leg 1 empty -> inline 'Pickup location is required' under Pickup Location (plus 'Selected date and time has already passed.' for the stale default time); no Leg 2 added, form scrolled back to Leg 1.
Multi Leg 1 Pickup Location: 'zqxkwjqpzx' -> blank list after 6 s, no 'No results' / empty-state message (no crash). BUG-LOC-001 still reproducible on app-release_7Oct26.apk.

After Leg 1 (Local, Majestic, 09-10 10:00 am, 4 pax, 4 h) Add Next Journey collapses Leg 1 into a chip 'Leg 1 : Majestic, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India ... | Edit | X' and opens 'Leg #2 Local'; choosing Outstation switches Leg 2 to Outstation fields (Pickup, Pickup Date & Time, First Destination *, + Add Another Destination, Drop Date & Time, Passengers, Different drop location). Leg 2 filled Majestic -> Mysuru 10-10 10:00 am to 11-10 09:00 pm and committed; chips have X (remove) and a new 'Edit' link.

PARTIALLY FIXED: Leg 3 pickup now defaults to Leg 2's destination (Mysuru) and Leg 4 'From' to Leg 3's drop (Majestic). Still wrong: every new leg's date/time defaults to the current time (Leg 2 = 08-10 09:40 am, Leg 3 = 08-10 09:44 am) - before the previous leg (Leg 1 09-10 10:00 am; Leg 2 ends 11-10 09:00 pm) instead of after its end. Leg 2 pickup also simply copied Leg 1's pickup (Local leg has no drop).

Leg 3 Transfer P2P Mysuru -> Majestic dated 08-10 10:00 am - 10:00 pm (before Leg 1 on 09-10 and Leg 2 on 10-11 Oct) committed with Add Next Journey without any warning; Trip Summary Leg 3 shows Dates '08 Oct, 2026'. No chronology/overlap validation between legs. Also Leg 3 distance shown as '> 30 KM' for Mysuru -> Majestic (~145 km).

(a) With a single fully filled open Leg 1 and nothing committed, Search Vehicles shows dialog 'Please add at least one journey to continue.' (b) With Legs 1-3 committed and Leg 4 Transfer fully filled (Majestic -> KIA, 12-10 09:46 am - 10:00 pm) but not committed, Search Vehicles opens Trip Summary with only Leg 1 / Leg 2 / Leg 3 tabs - Leg 4 silently dropped, no warning. BUG-MLT-002 still reproducible.

3 committed legs -> Search Vehicles -> 'Now you're ready to explore' with Leg 1 / Leg 2 / Leg 3 tabs: Leg 1 'Local Trip' Majestic -> Majestic, 80 KM, 09 Oct 2026, 4 Pax; Leg 2 'Outstation Trip' Majestic -> Mysuru -> Majestic, 285 KM, 10-11 Oct 2026; Leg 3 'Transfer (Point to Point)' Mysuru -> Majestic, '> 30 KM', 08 Oct 2026. Summary lists all committed legs; combined pricing now shown on Confirm (Rs 61,500, see TC_CONF_017). Leg distance/chronology issues logged under TC_HOME_068.

3-leg Multi (Local 4 h + Outstation 2 days + Transfer) -> Available Vehicles '20 vehicles found'; 33 Seater Deluxe Coach 'Starts From Rs 11,000' = Leg 1 (Local) alone, while Confirm for the same vehicle shows Estimated Grand Total Rs 61,500 (11,000 + 36,000 + 14,500). List price does not reflect all legs. Premium chip -> 7 vehicles (filtering works).

Premium chip -> '7 vehicles found'; chip cleared; Filters > Vehicle Type Sedan > Apply Filters -> '1 vehicles found' Sedan Rs 4,500; Filters > Reset All restores 20. (An Android 'Allow ... to send you notifications?' prompt appeared on opening Filters - answered Don't allow.)

FIXED: Confirm Your Trip now has Leg 1 / Leg 2 / Leg 3 tabs, each with its route summary (badge 'Multi-Leg (Local)' / 'Multi-Leg (Outstation)' ...), dates and estimate: Leg 1 Base 10,000 + Day Bata 1 x 1,000 + Night Bata 0 = Leg 1 Total Rs 11,000; Leg 2 (10-11 Oct, Pickup 10:00 am, Return 09:00 pm) Base 33,000 + Day Bata 2 x 1,000 + Night Bata 1 x 1,000 = Rs 36,000; Leg 3 Base 14,500 = Rs 14,500; Estimated Grand Total Rs 61,500 = sum of legs. BUG-MLT-004 Confirm part fixed (list price still Leg 1 only - TC_VLIST_013).

Single Confirm tap (approved) -> 'Inquiry Submitted Successfully!' Estimated Cost (Approx.) Rs 61,500 (combined - correct). But 3 separate, unlinked inquiries are created (Local Rs 11,000, Outstation 672 Rs 36,000, Transfer Rs 14,500) instead of one linked Multi booking; amounts now match the confirmed total (previously Rs 36,000 each).

Month > Inquired shows 3 independent cards: Local 'Majestic -> Majestic' 1 day 80 KM/Day Rs 11,000; Outstation 'Majestic -> Mysuru' 2 days 600 km Rs 36,000; Transfer 'Mysuru -> Majestic' 1 day '< 30 KM' Rs 14,500. Per-leg amounts now match Confirm (improved), but legs are not grouped/linked as one Multi trip, Outstation distance 600 km vs 285 KM on Trip Summary, Transfer '< 30 KM' vs '> 30 KM' on Summary (route ~145 km).

Inquiry 672 (Outstation leg): Distance 600 km (Trip Summary 285 KM), drop shown as 'Mysuru' (round trip back to Majestic), Schedule 10-11 Oct 2026, Pickup 10:00 am, Expected arrival '11 Oct, 2026, 10:00 pm' while the leg return time was 09:00 pm; Total Amount Rs 36000.00 (matches leg). Partially improved (no longer 0 km / Leg 1 end time).

Opened only the Outstation leg (672) > Cancel Trip: dialog 'Cancel Booking & Process Refund' Inquiry ID 672 only, Trip cost Rs 36,000 (leg amount - now consistent), slab '24 hrs <= T < 3 days', 20% + one day charge Rs 9,500 = penalty Rs 16,700, Refund Rs 19,300 on an unpaid inquiry; no statement of scope (this leg vs whole trip). Confirm -> 'Booking Cancelled (Inquiry #672)', invoice INV-81. Month > Inquired 52 -> 49: the Local and Transfer legs were also removed without warning. BUG-MLT-006 still reproducible; refund on unpaid inquiry = BUG-OUT-014.

cases.scenario: Edit a committed leg via the chip 'Edit' link (Update Leg / Cancel)
cases.preconditions: Multi with at least one committed leg and an open next leg
cases.steps: 1. Tap Edit on a leg chip 2. Change a value (e.g. hours 3 -> 5) 3. Tap Update Leg 4. Tap Edit again, then Cancel 5. Search Vehicles and check the summary
cases.testData: Leg 1 Transfer By Hour Majestic 16-10, 3 -> 5 hours
cases.expected: Edit opens 'Edit Leg #N' prefilled; Update Leg saves the change and returns to the open leg with its draft intact; Cancel leaves all legs and the open draft unchanged
cases.actual: Edit opens 'Edit Leg #1 Transfer' with all values prefilled, Cancel link and 'Update Leg' button; Update Leg saved hours 5 (verified on re-edit) and returned to the open leg. But Cancel in edit mode discarded the filled open leg draft (Leg #2 Majestic -> KIA 19-10 values reset to defaults).

Multi context: Clear with committed legs now shows a confirmation 'Delete your Multi trip? All the journeys you added under Multi will be deleted. You will have to add them again.' with KEEP TRIP / DELETE. Keep Trip leaves the legs intact; Delete removes all legs and leaves the Multi tab on a fresh 'Leg #1 Transfer' with defaults. (BUG-MLT-008 Clear part fixed.)

FIXED: with a committed leg, tapping the Local tab shows 'Delete your Multi trip? If you switch to another trip type, the journeys you added under Multi will be deleted. You will have to add them again.' with KEEP TRIP / DELETE; Keep Trip stays on Multi with the leg intact. BUG-MLT-008 verified fixed (switch type and Clear both confirm).

Leg 2 identical to Leg 1 (Local, Majestic, 11-10 ~10:10 am, 2 h - same pickup, same start, overlapping) committed without any duplicate/overlap warning; then Legs 3 and 4 committed (4 chips + open 'Leg #5') - no maximum enforced, no warnings. BUG-MLT-003 still reproducible.

With 4 committed legs and open Leg 5, the Multi form was scrolled rapidly up/down 8 times (and many legs added/edited/removed during the run): app stayed open, all chips and the open leg retained. The earlier crash (BUG-MLT-007) did not reproduce in this run.

Single-leg Multi inquiry 685 (Local, Majestic, 17-10-2026 10:17 am, 4 h, Rs 11,000; created this run): Cancel Trip -> slab 'T >= 7 days - fully refundable', Hours before trip start 8 days 23 hours, Penalty 0%, Add one day charge No, Penalty retained Rs 0.00 -> Confirm -> 'Booking Cancelled (Inquiry #685)', INV-82; Month Inquired 50 -> 49. Slab and 0% penalty correct. (Refund Rs 11,000 on an unpaid inquiry = BUG-OUT-014, not counted against this case.)
